content.text: Northwind needs a nightly shipment CSV on their SFTP server. Start with a cron job in the app worker.
Added the cron job in the app worker. It writes the CSV and uploads it over SFTP.
The staging run sent the export twice after the worker restarted. Northwind would double-count those shipments, that's a billing problem.

The cron job retries from scratch after a restart, so it can't tell the upload already happened. I'm dropping the cron approach and moving the export to the job queue with an idempotency key of client plus date, so a retry can't send a second file.
Good. Keep the column mapping in clients/northwind for now. Don't put it in core yet: their column names are odd and we'd need a second client to know what's generic.

Done. The queue job and idempotency key are in core/export, and the Northwind column mapping is in clients/northwind/mapping.py. The SFTP transport is also in clients/northwind, because nothing else uses it yet.
